characters.name: Goggles / Hoodie
characters.hair: Natural black short layered hair with relaxed side-swept fringe, modest volume, no tall spikes.
characters.expression: Startled disbelief: eyes widen, uneven raised brows, mouth open in a short crooked wedge.
characters.eyes: Flat amber irises with simple black pupils.
characters.clothing: Navy hoodie collar with visible ivory drawstrings.
characters.accessories: Compact dark grey goggles resting on forehead above brows.

characters.name: Studs / Shirt
characters.hair: Natural chestnut shoulder-length straight hair, soft wispy bangs, ends gently curve inward.
characters.expression: Skeptical: one brow lifted, slightly narrowed eyelids, lips parted at one corner.
characters.eyes: Flat olive-green irises with black pupils.
characters.clothing: Cream pointed shirt collar with a small dark green ribbon tie.
characters.accessories: Two small round silver stud earrings.

characters.name: Bandage / Polo
characters.hair: Everyday brown slightly messy short hair, a few soft irregular fringe locks, compact normal silhouette.
characters.expression: Irritated determination: brows pull inward, mouth clenched into a visible flat ivory tooth bar.
characters.eyes: Muted blue irises with black pupils.
characters.clothing: White open polo collar over a dark red undershirt edge.
characters.accessories: One small beige adhesive bandage on left cheek.

characters.name: Clip / Sailor
characters.hair: Normal neat black chin-length bob with a soft side fringe and rounded inward ends, no sculptural shapes.
characters.expression: Shocked alarm: both eyes wide, brows high but pinched, mouth open vertically with a sharp corner.
characters.eyes: Muted warm rust-brown irises with black pupils.
characters.clothing: Dark navy sailor collar with simple white edge piping.
characters.accessories: One small plain red rectangular hair clip beside right temple.

characters.name: Hoop / Denim
characters.hair: Soft ash-brown curtain hair parted near center, normal ear-length sides and low crown.
characters.expression: Confident challenge: one brow raised, one lowered, asymmetric closed-mouth smirk.
characters.eyes: Grey-green irises with black pupils.
characters.clothing: Muted blue denim turned-down jacket collar over black crew-neck.
characters.accessories: One small thin silver hoop earring in left ear.

characters.name: Nose plaster / Zip
characters.hair: Dark navy-black hair tied in a natural low ponytail, two loose short face-framing wisps, no huge fan or sharp fins.
characters.expression: Pained frustration: brows knit tightly, one eye slightly squinted, lips pressed into a tense crooked line.
characters.eyes: Muted teal irises with black pupils.
characters.clothing: Grey sports jacket zip-up collar with a narrow burgundy inner lining.
characters.accessories: Small beige strip bandage across nose bridge and two tiny healed scratch lines on one cheek; no blood.

characters.name: Stud / Knit
characters.hair: Natural dark brown soft fluffy short crop with light broken fringe, no shaved patterns.
characters.expression: Caught off guard: raised brows, one eyelid more compressed, half-open crooked mouth.
characters.eyes: Golden-brown irises with black pupils.
characters.clothing: Burgundy ribbed turtleneck collar, ribbing indicated by only a few lines.
characters.accessories: One tiny matte black ear stud.

characters.name: Scarf / Cheek plaster
characters.hair: Ash-blond shoulder-length hair with gentle everyday loose waves drawn as broad locks and a normal side part.
characters.expression: Exhausted uncertainty: lowered upper lids, inward-lifted brows, small slack open mouth.
characters.eyes: Muted smoky purple irises with black pupils.
characters.clothing: Loose dark navy scarf around white crew-neck shirt.
characters.accessories: One small beige adhesive plaster just below right cheekbone.

characters.name: Goggles / Flight collar
characters.hair: Ordinary black short undercut with longer soft forward fringe, natural low volume.
characters.expression: Tense protest: one eye wide, one compressed, strong lowered brows, broad open mouth.
characters.eyes: Muted green irises with black pupils.
characters.clothing: Cream flight jacket collar over a dark charcoal shirt.
characters.accessories: Small grey goggles resting loosely around neck and a tiny non-graphic cheek abrasion indicated by two muted red lines.

characters.name: Hairpin / Round neck
characters.hair: Warm black shoulder-length half-up hair, small natural rear tie, soft side bangs.
characters.expression: Playful but challenging: crooked open smile with a thin tooth edge, one brow raised.
characters.eyes: Warm amber irises with black pupils.
characters.clothing: Plain maroon round-neck top.
characters.accessories: Tiny gold star stud earrings and one small ivory hairpin.

characters.name: Chain / Open shirt
characters.hair: Normal dark blue-black medium center-parted anime hair with face-framing bangs and natural ear-length sides.
characters.expression: Suspicious doubt: lowered lids, one lifted inner brow, mouth slightly open sideways.
characters.eyes: Steel-blue-grey irises with black pupils.
characters.clothing: Charcoal open shirt collar showing a white undershirt edge.
characters.accessories: A thin simple silver chain visible at neckline.

characters.name: Hoop / Athletic zip
characters.hair: Natural copper ponytail tied high but falling down behind the head, soft curved fringe; NO fan-shaped ponytail or sculptural spikes.
characters.expression: Angry outburst: furrowed brows, uneven wide eyes, mouth open in a large sharp-edged shout.
characters.eyes: Hazel irises with black pupils.
characters.clothing: White athletic jacket collar with a dark navy zipper track.
characters.accessories: One small silver hoop earring and one beige cheek bandage.

characters.name: Brow plaster / Utility
characters.hair: Normal muted dark-blond short side-part hairstyle, compact crown, one relaxed fringe lock.
characters.expression: Amused disbelief: one brow lifted high, broad crooked grin with one simple ivory tooth plane.
characters.eyes: Warm brown irises with black pupils.
characters.clothing: Muted olive utility shirt pointed collar.
characters.accessories: Small beige adhesive plaster above right eyebrow and one tiny ear stud.

characters.name: Clip / Mock neck
characters.hair: Straight long black anime hair ending just beside shoulder tops, normal curtain bangs parted around eyes.
characters.expression: Stern skepticism: asymmetric low brows, half-narrowed eyes, closed tense mouth.
characters.eyes: Flat steel-grey irises with black pupils.
characters.clothing: Charcoal mock-neck top with a simple straight neckline.
characters.accessories: One thin silver bar hair clip at temple.

characters.name: Goggles / Loose tie
characters.hair: Natural chestnut tousled hair of ordinary short length, soft messy fringe and normal crown height.
characters.expression: Strong startled shock: raised pinched brows, large eyes, mouth open wider than the other portraits.
characters.eyes: Grey-green irises with black pupils.
characters.clothing: White shirt collar with a loose simple black tie.
characters.accessories: Dark grey goggles pushed onto the forehead, small flat lenses with no shiny rendering.

characters.name: Nose plaster / Hoodie
characters.hair: Dusty pink natural long bob, straight bangs separated lightly and softly inward-curved ends.
characters.expression: Quiet disbelief: one brow up, one low, lips slightly parted, eyes attentive.
characters.eyes: Very dark grey irises with black pupils.
characters.clothing: Navy hoodie neckline with a pale grey inner hood edge.
characters.accessories: Tiny silver hoop earrings and a small beige nose-bridge plaster.

characters.name: Bruise / Overshirt
characters.hair: Normal ink-black medium fringe parted just enough to reveal both eyes, ear-length layered sides.
characters.expression: Tired resilience: one eye narrowed, brows drawn inward, mouth half-open in a small strained grimace.
characters.eyes: Muted amber irises with black pupils.
characters.clothing: Tan overshirt collar over a cream crew-neck shirt.
characters.accessories: One small flat muted mauve bruise on cheek and two tiny shallow scratch marks; no blood, swelling or graphic injury.

characters.name: Studs / Sailor collar
characters.hair: Everyday dark-brown short layered pixie cut with a soft side fringe exposing ear lobes, no extreme shaved sides.
characters.expression: Defiant resolve: brows sharply lowered, direct eyes, clenched tooth bar showing at a crooked mouth corner.
characters.eyes: Muted olive-green irises with black pupils.
characters.clothing: White sailor collar with navy trim over a dark blue top.
characters.accessories: Small silver stud earrings and one short subtle scratch beside the temple, no blood.

characters.name: Ear cuff / Zip jacket
characters.hair: Ordinary dark-brown slightly wavy ear-length hair, relaxed side bangs and a modest natural silhouette.
characters.expression: Sarcastic confidence: one eyelid lowered, one brow arched, wide asymmetric open grin with one tooth plane.
characters.eyes: Muted blue irises with black pupils.
characters.clothing: Black high zip jacket collar with grey inner facing.
characters.accessories: One small silver ear cuff and compact grey goggles hanging at neckline.

characters.name: Drops / Sweater
characters.hair: Natural silver-brown straight shoulder-length hair with simple center part and a few loose face-framing locks.
characters.expression: Vulnerable confusion: inner brows lifted, eyes open unequally, small uncertain parted mouth.
characters.eyes: Muted violet-grey irises with black pupils.
characters.clothing: Cream softly ribbed sweater collar with only a few simple rib lines.
characters.accessories: Small plain silver teardrop earrings and one beige adhesive plaster at brow edge.
